releaseNotes: 1. Security hardening: cloud D1 tunnel addresses now use transparent AES-256-GCM encryption, strictly isolating client and web session permissions and adding PKCE binding validation. 2. Terminal protection: upgraded the built-in Go native password gate (prevents signal-interruption bypass) and strengthened WebRTC/local-loopback interface authentication. 3. Local security: client tokens migrate to an AES-GCM hardware-derived encryption vault (0600 permissions), and account logout automatically rotates the underlying WireGuard keys.
